about_the_game:
In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso®, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

◘ 2D Painting
◘ Art Gallery Missions & Auctions
◘ Open World City Environment
◘ Skill Leveling and Upgrades
◘ Day/Night System
◘ 32Bit Pixel Art Graphics
◘ Purchasable Properties & Furniture Upgrades⦾ Fishing 
⦾ Stealth Mechanics

⦾ Updated Lighting Systems

Keyboard/Mouse:
Movement - up/down/left/right 
Action 1 - F
Action 2 - E
Action 3 - G
Action 4 - R
Quick Slots - W/A/S/D
Walk Mode- Shift/Ctrl
Zoom - Alt
Main Menu - Esc
Aim - Y / Right Click
Attack - J / Left Click

Game Pad:
(Playstation)
Movement - Left Stick 
Action 1 - X
Action 2 - Square
Action 3 - Circle
Action 4 - Triangle
Quick Slots - D-Pad
Walk Mode- R1/L1
Zoom - L3
Main Menu - Start
Aim - L2

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100, AMD FX4350 or equivalent.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB, AMD Radeon R9 290 4GB, or equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590, AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, or better.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 480, or better.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
